nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet

nodes.label: Ba tien de ra doi chu nghia Mac
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: ba tien de ra doi chu nghia mac
nodes.rationale: Three premises: classical German philosophy, natural science, and practice of the proletarian revolution.

nodes.label: Bay hay gap va meo nho (MLN111)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: bay hay gap va meo nho (mln111)
nodes.rationale: Exam traps: absolute words, mixing up law names, confusing productive force roles, numeric counts; a list of commonly tested distinctions.

nodes.label: Phep bien chung duy vat (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Dialectics chapter: two principles, three laws, six pairs of categories; heavily tested trap-prone topic.

nodes.label: Cach mang xa hoi
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Fundamental change of socioeconomic formation; core is transferring state power; distinguished from reform and coup.

nodes.label: Sau cap pham tru bien chung
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: sau cap pham tru bien chung
nodes.rationale: Six category pairs: general-individual-singular, cause-effect, necessity-chance, content-form, essence-phenomenon, possibility-reality.

nodes.label: Chan ly (4 tinh chat)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Truth is objective, relative, absolute and concrete, verified by practice.

nodes.label: Con nguoi (ban chat va tha hoa)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: con nguoi (ban chat va tha hoa)
nodes.rationale: Marxist view of humans as biosocial beings whose essence is the ensemble of social relations.

nodes.label: Dan toc
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Highest community form; characteristics include territory, language, economy, culture; class determines the solution to the national question.

nodes.label: Chu nghia duy tam (2 phai)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Subjective and objective idealism; common root is one-sided, absolutised spiritual dimension.

nodes.label: Chu nghia duy vat (3 hinh thuc)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: chu nghia duy vat (3 hinh thuc)
nodes.rationale: Ancient naive materialism, 17th-18th century metaphysical materialism, and dialectical materialism of Marx, Engels and Lenin.

nodes.label: Giai cap (dinh nghia Lenin)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Classes differ in position within a system of social production, mainly in relation to ownership of means of production (Lenin, Great Initiative).

nodes.label: Giai cap, dan toc, nha nuoc, cach mang (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: giai cap, dan toc, nha nuoc, cach mang (chapter)
nodes.rationale: Historical materialism on politics and society: classes, nation, state, revolution, masses and leaders.

nodes.label: Co so ha tang va kien truc thuong tang
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: co so ha tang va kien truc thuong tang
nodes.rationale: Base is the economic structure; superstructure is ideology and political institutions; base determines superstructure, which acts back.

nodes.label: Hinh thai KT-XH va ton tai, y thuc xa hoi (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: hinh thai kt-xh va ton tai, y thuc xa hoi (chapter)
nodes.rationale: Five socioeconomic formations, social being and social consciousness.

nodes.label: Luc luong san xuat (LLSX)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Productive forces = workers plus means of production; workers are decisive, tools most dynamic and revolutionary.

nodes.label: Nha nuoc
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: State arises from irreconcilable class antagonism; instrument of the ruling class; three features in the course textbook.

nodes.label: Ly luan nhan thuc (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Epistemology chapter: practice as foundation, sensory and rational stages, and truth criteria.

nodes.label: Nhi nguyen luan
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Dualist position that matter and spirit jointly determine the origin of the world.

nodes.label: Quan he san xuat (QHSX)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Production relations: ownership of means of production (decisive), organisation and management, distribution.

nodes.label: Quan chung nhan dan va lanh tu
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: quan chung nhan dan va lanh tu
nodes.rationale: Masses are the true creators of history; leaders are products of the era; idealist view that heroes make history is rejected.

nodes.label: Quy luat luong - chat
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Law of quantity-quality transformation: reveals the manner of development through nodes and leaps.

nodes.label: Quy luat thong nhat va dau tranh cac mat doi lap
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: quy luat thong nhat va dau tranh cac mat doi lap
nodes.rationale: Law of contradiction: reveals the source and driving force of development.

nodes.label: Quy luat phu dinh cua phu dinh
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: quy luat phu dinh cua phu dinh
nodes.rationale: Law of negation of negation: reveals the direction of development, spiral form, inheritance.

nodes.label: Quy luat QHSX phu hop voi trinh do LLSX
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: quy luat qhsx phu hop voi trinh do llsx
nodes.rationale: Most basic law of social history: productive forces determine production relations, which act back to promote or hinder.

nodes.label: San xuat xa hoi, LLSX, QHSX (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: san xuat xa hoi, llsx, qhsx (chapter)
nodes.rationale: Historical materialism chapter on social production, productive forces, production relations, and base-superstructure.

nodes.label: Su ra doi triet hoc Mac-Lenin (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: su ra doi triet hoc mac-lenin (chapter)
nodes.rationale: Chapter on origins, three premises and three components of Marxist-Leninist philosophy.

nodes.label: Tha hoa con nguoi
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Alienation of labour: products of labour become alien powers; specific to class societies with private ownership.

nodes.label: The gioi quan
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Worldview as the most general system of views; philosophy is its theoretical core; scientific worldview core is dialectical materialism.

nodes.label: Thuc tien (co so, dong luc, tieu chuan chan ly)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: thuc tien (co so, dong luc, tieu chuan chan ly)
nodes.rationale: Practice is basis, driving force, purpose and criterion of truth; Lenin: practice is the first and basic viewpoint.

nodes.label: Tinh the cach mang (Lenin 3 dau hieu)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: tinh the cach mang (lenin 3 dau hieu)
nodes.rationale: Objective condition for revolution: rulers cannot rule as before, masses suffer more, mass activity rises; subjective factor decides outcome.

nodes.label: Ton tai xa hoi
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Material life of society: mode of production, population, geographic conditions; determines social consciousness.

nodes.label: Triet hoc va van de co ban (chapter)
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: triet hoc va van de co ban (chapter)

nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.norm_label: van de co ban cua triet hoc

nodes.label: Y thuc xa hoi
nodes.community_name: Bang dap an cau 101-586 / Bay dao vai tro va tuyet
nodes.rationale: Spiritual life of society: relative independence, can lag or lead, acts back on social being; ordinary vs theoretical, psychology vs ideology.
